definitions.explanation: The number thirteen. Formed by combining {十|じゅう} (ten) and {三|さん} (three).

notes:
{十三|じゅうさん} is the number thirteen, formed by combining {十|じゅう} (ten) and {三|さん} (three).

COMMON USES:
- {十三|じゅうさん}{歳|さい}: thirteen years old
- {十三|じゅうさん}{人|にん}: thirteen people
- {十三|じゅうさん}{日|にち}: the 13th day (of the month)
- {十三|じゅうさん}{時|じ}: 1 PM (13:00 in 24-hour time)

CULTURE:
Unlike in Western cultures where 13 is considered unlucky, there is no particular superstition around this number in Japan. However, the concept of 'Friday the 13th' ({十三|じゅうさん}{日|にち}の{金曜日|きんようび}) has been introduced through Western media.
